theme_central: The expulsion of the Banu Nadir as concrete proof of Allah's power — opening and closing on His glorification, of which seventeen attributes are listed in the final three verses.
sources_note: 3-section structure precisely sourced (slideshare.net, alim.org): 1-5, 6-10, 11-17. Closing (18-24, the most beautiful names) widely documented.

branches.title: Expulsion of the Banu Nadir
branches.resume: The Jewish tribe of Banu Nadir expelled from Medina for betraying the covenant.

children.t: Expulsion of the Banu Nadir for betraying the covenant with the Muslims

branches.title: Distribution of goods, qualities of the believers
branches.resume: Distribution of the Banu Nadir's goods, qualities of the emigrants and the helpers.

children.t: Distribution of goods; qualities of the emigrants (muhajirun) and helpers (ansar)

branches.title: Betrayal of the hypocrites
branches.resume: Promises of support from the hypocrites toward the Banu Nadir, then flight at the decisive moment.

children.t: Hypocrites promising their support then fleeing at the decisive moment

branches.title: Closing: the most beautiful names
branches.resume: Exhortation to prepare for the hereafter, closing on seventeen divine attributes.

children.t: Looking at what one has prepared for tomorrow, fearing Allah
Closing: seventeen divine attributes listed (al-asma al-husna)
